data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Armodios', meaning 'powerful' or 'mighty'. The suffix '-ilda' is derived from 'hild', meaning 'battle' or 'soldier'. This name was popular among the Germanic peoples and was borne by several early saints. The name Armilda carries the meaning “Powerful, Soldier” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armilda usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, soldier and live with faith, good character and purpose.
